title: Design System
problem: The bank needed reusable components that designers and developers could understand and apply consistently.
overview: A shared set of components and patterns supports the bank’s products across devices.
role: I worked with designers and developers to build and refine components in Figma.

sections.title: The project

list: Preserve the bank’s visual identity across products.
Document how to use and combine components.

blocks: A design system needs clear guidance as well as reusable parts. Teams must understand when to use a pattern and how to adapt it.

sections.title: Design Process
blocks: We reviewed the brand and user needs, defined shared patterns, and refined components through feedback. Documentation recorded decisions and supported future updates.

list: Label form fields and write helpful error messages.
Document the system and support adoption.
Create a way for teams to propose and share improvements.
